lead_raw_text:
The structure of ScAlCu2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 194), with a unit cell containing four atoms—Sc, Al, and two Cu—distributed across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies all three elements as 12-coordinate, each with a close-packed-like local arrangement, and the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Cu–Cu 12-vertex coordination polyhedra linked through corner, edge, and face contacts, while Al–Cu and Al–Sc polyhedra share edges and Sc–Cu pairs share corners and faces.
